_comment: Categories for the secrets agent. Patterns use * as a wildcard and match case-insensitively; the first matching category wins. The first request for a key in a category that is not yet unlocked triggers a fresh master-password popup. Edit this file to recategorize without re-encrypting the vault.
_comment_bulk: Categories unlocked together by 'load-secrets-from-agent --bulk' (one popup). Keys in other categories still need their own unlock.
_comment_extra_files: Optional extra vaults merged into the agent at start. ~ is your home directory; relative paths resolve against SECRETS_DIR. The first file loaded wins on duplicate keys.
